fct_github_day_surprise.content:
name: fct_github_day_surprise
description: 'Metric 4 backup: each counted day against the weekday-and-trend prediction from the days before it. One row per activity per day up to release day with a same-weekday day before it; release day is one row, the rest are placebos. Population: Every counted day up to release day with at least one earlier day on the same weekday (the first week cannot be predicted).'
model: ref('fct_github_day_surprise')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: candidate_date
dimensions:
  - name: activity
    type: categorical
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: candidate_date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: The day scored.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: is_release_day
    type: categorical
    description: True on GTA 6's release day; every other row is a placebo.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
measures:
  - name: fit_days
    agg: max
    expr: fit_days
    description: Counted days before the candidate the model was fitted on.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: days
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: df
    agg: max
    expr: df
    description: 'Degrees of freedom: fit days - weekdays - 1.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: daily_trend
    agg: max
    expr: daily_trend
    description: Fitted trend, log points per day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: log points per day
          null_rule: NULL when the fit has no spread.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: expected_count
    agg: max
    expr: expected_count
    description: What the days before predict for the candidate.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: observed_count
    agg: max
    expr: observed_count
    description: The candidate's count.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: pct_vs_expected
    agg: max
    expr: pct_vs_expected
    description: Observed against expected, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: t_stat
    agg: max
    expr: t_stat
    description: Gap in prediction standard errors. NULL with under the minimum history.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: standard errors
          null_rule: NULL under the minimum history or df < 5.
          additivity: non_additive
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: Every counted day up to release day with at least one earlier day on the same weekday (the first week cannot be predicted).
        parent:
          model: fct_github_daily
          key:
            activity: activity
            candidate_date: activity_date
      assumptions:
        - decision: What 'normal' release day would have been
          chosen: log(count) = weekday level + linear trend, fitted on every counted day before the candidate; one-sided t on the prediction error
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user, 20 Nov: a formal hypothesis test that the drop is significant; the model was fixed before the result was computed: weekday levels for the weekly cycle, a trend for GitHub''s growth, logs so changes are relative'
          column: t_stat
        - decision: Placebos
          chosen: the same test on every earlier day with >= 21 days of history
          evidence: default
          detail: 'an empirical check that does not lean on the t distribution: how often an ordinary day lands this far below its prediction'
          column: is_release_day
        - decision: Days without a same-weekday day before them
          chosen: left out (nothing to predict them from)
          evidence: default
          detail: the first week of the series (1-7 Oct)
          column: candidate_date

name: fct_github_release_day_test
description: 'Metric 4 backup: the release-day hypothesis test, one row per activity. Population: One row per activity with a release-day row in fct_github_day_surprise.'
model: ref('fct_github_release_day_test')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: release_day
entities:
  - name: activity
    type: primary
    expr: activity
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
dimensions:
  - name: release_day
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: GTA 6's release day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
measures:
  - name: fit_days
    agg: max
    expr: fit_days
    description: Days the release-day prediction was fitted on.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: days
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: df
    agg: max
    expr: df
    description: Degrees of freedom of the primary test.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: expected_count
    agg: max
    expr: expected_count
    description: Release day as predicted from the days before it.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: observed_count
    agg: max
    expr: observed_count
    description: Release day as counted.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: pct_vs_expected
    agg: max
    expr: pct_vs_expected
    description: Observed against expected, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: t_stat
    agg: max
    expr: t_stat
    description: Primary test statistic (Student t, df above).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: standard errors
          null_rule: NULL under the minimum history.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: placebo_days
    agg: max
    expr: placebo_days
    description: Earlier days scored the same way.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: placebo_days_as_low
    agg: max
    expr: placebo_days_as_low
    description: Placebo days with a t at or below release day's.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: placebo_p
    agg: max
    expr: placebo_p
    description: '(as low + 1) / (placebo days + 1): the share of days, release day included, this far below their prediction.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: fraction
          null_rule: NULL without a release-day t.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: weekday_n
    agg: max
    expr: weekday_n
    description: Earlier same-weekday week-on-week changes.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: weekday_wow_mean
    agg: max
    expr: weekday_wow_mean
    description: Their mean, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL without earlier changes.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: weekday_wow_sd
    agg: max
    expr: weekday_wow_sd
    description: Their standard deviation, in percent points.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL with fewer than two.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: release_wow
    agg: max
    expr: release_wow
    description: Release day's week-on-week change, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL when either day is missing.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: weekday_t
    agg: max
    expr: weekday_t
    description: Release day's change against the earlier ones, in prediction SDs.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: standard errors
          null_rule: NULL with fewer than 3 earlier changes.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: weekday_df
    agg: max
    expr: weekday_df
    description: weekday_n - 1.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: NULL without earlier changes.
          additivity: non_additive
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: One row per activity with a release-day row in fct_github_day_surprise.
        parent:
          model: fct_github_release_day_activities
          key:
            activity: activity
      assumptions:
        - decision: Placebo p-value
          chosen: (placebo days at or below release day's t + 1) / (placebo days + 1)
          evidence: default
          detail: the standard rank p-value that counts release day itself, so it is never zero
          column: placebo_p
        - decision: Thursday check
          chosen: release day's week-on-week change against the earlier same-weekday changes, prediction t with n - 1 df
          evidence: default
          detail: uses only the Thursdays, with no model of the trend
          column: weekday_t

--- /dev/null
+++ b/models/marts/fct_github_day_surprise.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+-- Metric 4 backup: how far each day's count lands from what the days before it predict.
+-- Per activity and candidate day: fit log(count) = a level per weekday + one linear trend on
+-- the counted days BEFORE the candidate only, predict the candidate, and measure the gap in
+-- prediction standard errors. Release day is one candidate; the earlier ones are placebos.
+{%- set release_day = var('github_release_day') %}
+{%- set min_fit_days = var('github_test_min_fit_days', 21) %}
+with daily as (
+    select
+        activity,
+        activity_date,
+        ln(activity_count) as y,
+        cast(date_diff('day', date '{{ release_day }}', activity_date) as double) as t,
+        isodow(activity_date) as dow
+    from {{ ref('fct_github_daily') }}
+    where activity_count > 0
+        and activity_date <= date '{{ release_day }}'
+),
+
+fit as (
+    select
+        candidate.activity,
+        candidate.activity_date as candidate_date,
+        history.y,
+        history.t,
+        history.dow
+    from daily as candidate
+    inner join daily as history
+        on candidate.activity = history.activity
+        and history.activity_date < candidate.activity_date
+),
+
+weekday_means as (
+    select
+        activity,
+        candidate_date,
+        dow,
+        avg(t) as mean_t,
+        avg(y) as mean_y,
+        count(*) as weekday_days
+    from fit
+    group by activity, candidate_date, dow
+),
+
+centered as (
+    select
+        fit.activity,
+        fit.candidate_date,
+        fit.t - weekday_means.mean_t as tc,
+        fit.y - weekday_means.mean_y as yc
+    from fit
+    inner join weekday_means
+        on fit.activity = weekday_means.activity
+        and fit.candidate_date = weekday_means.candidate_date
+        and fit.dow = weekday_means.dow
+),
+
+trend as (
+    select
+        activity,
+        candidate_date,
+        count(*) as fit_days,
+        sum(tc * yc) / nullif(sum(tc * tc), 0) as daily_trend,
+        sum(tc * tc) as sxx
+    from centered
+    group by activity, candidate_date
+),
+
+weekdays as (
+    select activity, candidate_date, count(*) as weekdays
+    from weekday_means
+    group by activity, candidate_date
+),
+
+residuals as (
+    select
+        centered.activity,
+        centered.candidate_date,
+        sum(power(centered.yc - trend.daily_trend * centered.tc, 2)) as ssr
+    from centered
+    inner join trend
+        on centered.activity = trend.activity
+        and centered.candidate_date = trend.candidate_date
+    group by centered.activity, centered.candidate_date
+),
+
+scored as (
+    select
+        daily.activity,
+        daily.activity_date as candidate_date,
+        trend.fit_days,
+        trend.fit_days - weekdays.weekdays - 1 as df,
+        trend.daily_trend,
+        weekday_means.mean_y + trend.daily_trend * (daily.t - weekday_means.mean_t)
+            as expected_log,
+        daily.y as observed_log,
+        residuals.ssr / nullif(trend.fit_days - weekdays.weekdays - 1, 0) as residual_var,
+        1 + 1.0 / weekday_means.weekday_days
+            + power(daily.t - weekday_means.mean_t, 2) / nullif(trend.sxx, 0) as variance_factor
+    from daily
+    inner join trend
+        on daily.activity = trend.activity
+        and daily.activity_date = trend.candidate_date
+    inner join weekdays
+        on daily.activity = weekdays.activity
+        and daily.activity_date = weekdays.candidate_date
+    inner join residuals
+        on daily.activity = residuals.activity
+        and daily.activity_date = residuals.candidate_date
+    inner join weekday_means
+        on daily.activity = weekday_means.activity
+        and daily.activity_date = weekday_means.candidate_date
+        and daily.dow = weekday_means.dow
+)
+
+select
+    md5(activity || '|' || cast(candidate_date as varchar)) as github_surprise_key,
+    activity,
+    candidate_date,
+    candidate_date = date '{{ release_day }}' as is_release_day,
+    fit_days,
+    df,
+    daily_trend,
+    exp(expected_log) as expected_count,
+    exp(observed_log) as observed_count,
+    100 * (exp(observed_log - expected_log) - 1) as pct_vs_expected,
+    case
+        when fit_days >= {{ min_fit_days }} and df >= 5 and residual_var > 0
+            then (observed_log - expected_log) / sqrt(residual_var * variance_factor)
+    end as t_stat
+from scored

+++ b/models/marts/fct_github_release_day_test.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+-- Metric 4 backup: the release-day test, one row per activity. The primary test (release
+-- day against the weekday-and-trend prediction from the days before it), its placebo rank
+-- among the earlier days, and the Thursday check (release day's week-on-week change against
+-- the earlier same-weekday changes). p-values are read from t and df downstream.
+{%- set release_day = var('github_release_day') %}
+with surprise as (
+    select * from {{ ref('fct_github_day_surprise') }}
+),
+
+release as (
+    select * from surprise where is_release_day
+),
+
+placebos as (
+    select
+        release.activity,
+        count(surprise.t_stat) as placebo_days,
+        count(surprise.t_stat) filter (where surprise.t_stat <= release.t_stat)
+            as placebo_days_as_low
+    from release
+    left join surprise
+        on release.activity = surprise.activity
+        and surprise.candidate_date < release.candidate_date
+    group by release.activity
+),
+
+weekday as (
+    select
+        activity,
+        count(wow_pct_change) filter (where not is_release_day) as weekday_n,
+        avg(wow_pct_change) filter (where not is_release_day) as weekday_wow_mean,
+        stddev_samp(wow_pct_change) filter (where not is_release_day) as weekday_wow_sd,
+        max(wow_pct_change) filter (where is_release_day) as release_wow
+    from {{ ref('fct_github_daily') }}
+    where dayofweek(activity_date) = dayofweek(date '{{ release_day }}')
+        and activity_date <= date '{{ release_day }}'
+    group by activity
+)
+
+select
+    release.activity,
+    release.candidate_date as release_day,
+    release.fit_days,
+    release.df,
+    release.expected_count,
+    release.observed_count,
+    release.pct_vs_expected,
+    release.t_stat,
+    placebos.placebo_days,
+    placebos.placebo_days_as_low,
+    case
+        when release.t_stat is not null and placebos.placebo_days > 0
+            then (placebos.placebo_days_as_low + 1.0) / (placebos.placebo_days + 1)
+    end as placebo_p,
+    weekday.weekday_n,
+    weekday.weekday_wow_mean,
+    weekday.weekday_wow_sd,
+    weekday.release_wow,
+    case
+        when weekday.weekday_n >= 3 and weekday.weekday_wow_sd > 0
+            then (weekday.release_wow - weekday.weekday_wow_mean)
+                / (weekday.weekday_wow_sd * sqrt(1 + 1.0 / weekday.weekday_n))
+    end as weekday_t,
+    weekday.weekday_n - 1 as weekday_df
+from release
+inner join placebos
+    on release.activity = placebos.activity
+left join weekday
+    on release.activity = weekday.activity
